title: Phase 2c: pre-registered confirmation of Fed-MediShield bsc_5 with an oracle-relative utility criterion
relationship_to_phase_2b: Phase 2b (seeds 53-57) remains NOT SUPPORTED and is reported unchanged. Its post-hoc oracle analysis (addendum A10) showed the attacked-run criterion 'F1 >= clean FedAvg - 2 pp' was failed by perfect detection itself on seed 55, because excluding attackers removes their genuine rare-class data. Phase 2c replaces ONLY that criterion with one relative to the perfect-detection ceiling, on fresh seeds. The new tolerance (1.5 pp) was chosen after seeing Phase 2b (MediShield - oracle: -0.37 +/- 0.60 pp, worst -1.04 pp); this is disclosed and is why fresh seeds are required. Every other criterion is unchanged from Phase 2b.

protocol.attack: --poison-rate 0.5 --malicious-ratio 0.25, constant trigger columns 5 6 7 8 value 5, target Benign, every round from round 1
protocol.perfect_detection_reference: medishield_candidate.py --stage oracle --oracle-aggregation residual (evaluator-only, NOT a defence)

definitions: Identical to PREREGISTRATION_phase2b_bsc5.json (excess, attack rounds, exposure rounds > 10 pp, post-exposure window rounds 4-15).

per_seed_criteria.inconclusive_if: matched FedAvg attacked final ASR < 50%, or the oracle reference run is missing

reported_not_gated: attacked-run F1 vs clean FedAvg (the Phase 2b criterion)
oracle F1 vs clean FedAvg (unavoidable exclusion cost)
decision_rule: Supported only if every conclusive seed passes every criterion AND at least four seeds are conclusive. All seeds reported individually; mean and sample SD over seeds. No change after data are seen.
evaluation_script: logs/evaluate_phase2c_bsc5.py (written with this file, before data)
claim_if_supported: Against this single attack configuration on this dataset, bsc_5 removes the backdoor and stays within 1.5 F1 points of perfect detection, without degrading clean training beyond the stated limits. Nothing about other attacks, triggers, datasets or adaptive attackers.
not_tested: other attacker counts and poison rates
other datasets and the official test split
